sources.title: Hybrid Retrieval Methods - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: Hybrid retrieval is a unified framework that combines sparse (lexical) and dense (semantic) retrieval methods to leverage complementary strengths. It employs fusion strategies like reciprocal rank fusion, score interpolation, and dynamic weighting to optimize performance across text, image, and structured data modalities.

sources.snippet: Creating a Pipeline for Hybrid Retrieval Hybrid retrieval refers to the combination of multiple retrieval methods to enhance overall performance. In the context of search systems, a hybrid retrieval pipeline executes both traditional keyword-based search and dense vector search, later ranking the results with a cross-encoder model.
